info.name: Incident Response Service (UC4)
info.description:
Drive the incident-response process end-to-end.

RUN ORDER:
1) 1 - Raise incident (saves {{incidentId}}).
2) Wait ~25-30s for the automated chain (AI triage -> DMN classify -> parallel branches) to reach the human tasks.
3) 3 - List active tasks (saves {{taskKey}} + {{taskKey2}}).
4) Complete task(s): the parallel phase has TWO tasks (Containment Verification + Forensic Analysis) -> run 'Complete task by key' then 'Complete 2nd task by key'. Every later phase has ONE task -> run 'Complete active task'.
5) Re-run 'List active tasks' between phases; repeat until it returns []. Order: [Containment + Forensic] -> CISO Review -> Integrity Verification -> File Regulatory Notification -> Incident Closure.
6) 'Get incident' shows status CLOSED; 'Task outcomes' shows the persisted results.

Base URL variable {{baseUrl}} defaults to http://localhost:8080.

request.description: Liveness/readiness. UP also confirms the Camunda SaaS connection is healthy.
Full OpenAPI spec. Swagger UI at {{baseUrl}}/swagger-ui/index.html
Starts the incident-response process. Triage inputs make this a P1 (full response). Saves {{incidentId}}.
Exception path: automated isolation fails -> BPMN error -> escalates to the Incident Commander ('Handle Isolation Failure' task). Saves {{incidentId}}.

exec: console.log('incidentId =', j.data.id, '(expect severity P4 -> AUTO_CLOSED, no human tasks)');

request.description: Request-driven DMN: attackConfirmed=false -> the Incident Classification DMN returns P4 -> the P4 gateway auto-closes the incident (status AUTO_CLOSED). No parallel branches, no human tasks. Verify with 'Get incident'.

item.name: Raise incident (P2 - contained, no data loss)

exec: console.log('incidentId =', j.data.id, '(expect severity P2; regulatory branch skipped since dataExposed=false)');

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Contained breach, no data exfiltration",
  "source": "SIEM",
  "attackConfirmed": true,
  "assetCriticality": "HIGH",
  "dataExposed": false,
  "recordCount": 0
}

request.description: Request-driven DMN: HIGH criticality but no data exposed -> severity P2 (full response, drive it to CLOSED via the human tasks). The Regulatory Notification DMN returns false (dataExposed=false), so the 'File Regulatory Notification' task is skipped. Saves {{incidentId}}.
Current incident: severity + status (RAISED -> TRIAGED -> CLASSIFIED -> RECOVERING -> CLOSED).

exec: console.log('Active tasks:', items.map(t => t.name + ' [' + t.userTaskKey + ']').join(', ') || '(none yet - wait a few seconds and retry)');

request.description: Active Tasklist user tasks for the incident. Saves the first key to {{taskKey}} and the second (parallel phase) to {{taskKey2}}. Returns [] once the flow is past all human tasks.
